items.t: DoorDash (DASH) Brings Ride Rewards And Food Credits Together In Lyft Go
items.sum: DoorDash (NasdaqGS:DASH) and Lyft have launched Lyft Go, a joint rewards and ordering program linking rides with food delivery credits. The partnership integrates DoorDash restaurant ordering directly inside the Lyft app for eligible users in supported US markets.
